tools.description:
Runs a Powershell command (Windows) and returns its output.

Examples of valid command strings:

- ls -a (show hidden): "Get-ChildItem -Force"
- recursive find by name: "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.py"
- recursive grep: "Get-ChildItem -Path C:\\myrepo -Recurse | Select-String -Pattern 'TODO' -CaseSensitive"
- ps aux | grep python: "Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like '*python*' }"
- setting an env var: "$env:FOO='bar'; echo $env:FOO"
- running an inline Python script: "@'\\nprint('Hello, world!')\\n'@ | python -"

Windows safety rules:
- Do not compose destructive filesystem commands across shells. Do not enumerate paths in PowerShell and then pass them to `cmd /c`, batch builtins, or another shell for deletion or moving. Use one shell end-to-end, prefer native PowerShell cmdlets such as `Remove-Item` / `Move-Item` with `-LiteralPath`, and avoid string-built shell commands for file operations.
- Before any recursive delete or move on Windows, verify the resolved absolute target paths stay within the intended workspace or explicitly named target directory. Never issue a recursive delete or move against a computed path if the final target has not been checked.
- When using `Start-Process` to launch a background helper or service, pass `-WindowStyle Hidden` unless the user explicitly asked for a visible interactive window. Use visible windows only for interactive tools the user needs to see or control.
tools.name: shell_command

command.description: Shell script to run in the user's default shell.

justification.description: User-facing approval question for `require_escalated`; omit otherwise.

login.description: True runs with login shell semantics; false disables them. Defaults to true.

prefix_rule.description: Reusable approval prefix for `cmd`, only with `sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated"`; for example ["git", "pull"].

sandbox_permissions.description: Per-command sandbox override. Defaults to `use_default`; use `require_escalated` for unsandboxed execution.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum command runtime. Defaults to 10000 ms.

workdir.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the turn cwd.

tools.description:
Available model overrides (optional; inherited parent model is preferred):
- `gpt-5.5`: Frontier model for complex coding, research, and real-world work. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-5.4`: Strong model for everyday coding. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-5.4-mini`: Small, fast, and cost-efficient model for simpler coding tasks. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh.
- `gpt-5.3-codex`: Coding-optimized model. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh.
- `gpt-5.2`: Optimized for professional work and long-running agents. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh.
        Spawn a sub-agent for a well-scoped task. Returns the spawned agent id plus the user-facing nickname when available. Spawned agents inherit your current model by default. Omit `model` to use that preferred default; set `model` only when an explicit override is needed.
This spawn_agent tool provides you access to sub-agents that inherit your current model by default. Do not set the `model` field unless the user explicitly asks for a different model or there is a clear task-specific reason. You should follow the rules and guidelines below to use this tool.

Do not spawn sub-agents unless the user explicitly asks for sub-agents, delegation, or parallel agent work.
Agent-role guidance below only helps choose which agent to use after spawning is already authorized; it never authorizes spawning by itself.

### Designing delegated subtasks
- Subtasks must be concrete, well-defined, and self-contained.
- Delegated subtasks must materially advance the main task.
- Do not duplicate work between the main rollout and delegated subtasks.
- Avoid issuing multiple delegate calls on the same unresolved thread unless the new delegated task is genuinely different and necessary.
- Narrow the delegated ask to the concrete output you need next.
- For coding tasks, prefer delegating concrete code-change worker subtasks over read-only explorer analysis when the subagent can make a bounded patch in a clear write scope.
- When delegating coding work, instruct the submodel to edit files directly in its forked workspace and list the file paths it changed in the final answer.
- For code-edit subtasks, decompose work so each delegated task has a disjoint write set.

### After you delegate
- Call wait_agent very sparingly. Only call wait_agent when you need the result immediately for the next critical-path step and you are blocked until it returns.
- Do not redo delegated subagent tasks yourself; focus on integrating results or tackling non-overlapping work.
- While the subagent is running in the background, do meaningful non-overlapping work immediately.
- Do not repeatedly wait by reflex.
- When a delegated coding task returns, quickly review the uploaded changes, then integrate or refine them.

### Parallel delegation patterns
- Run multiple independent information-seeking subtasks in parallel when you have distinct questions that can be answered independently.
- Split implementation into disjoint codebase slices and spawn multiple agents for them in parallel when the write scopes do not overlap.
- Delegate verification only when it can run in parallel with ongoing implementation and is likely to catch a concrete risk before final integration.
- The key is to find opportunities to spawn multiple independent subtasks in parallel within the same round, while ensuring each subtask is well-defined, self-contained, and materially advances the main task.

tools.description:
Update the existing goal.
Use this tool only to mark the goal achieved or genuinely blocked.
Set status to `complete` only when the objective has actually been achieved and no required work remains.
Set status to `blocked` only when the same blocking condition has repeated for at least three consecutive goal turns, counting the original/user-triggered turn and any automatic continuations, and the agent cannot make meaningful progress without user input or an external-state change.
If the user resumes a goal that was previously marked `blocked`, treat the resumed run as a fresh blocked audit. If the same blocking condition then repeats for at least three consecutive resumed goal turns, set status to `blocked` again.
Once the blocked threshold is satisfied, do not keep reporting that you are still blocked while leaving the goal active; set status to `blocked`.
Do not use `blocked` merely because the work is hard, slow, uncertain, incomplete, or would benefit from clarification.
Do not mark a goal complete merely because its budget is nearly exhausted or because you are stopping work.
You cannot use this tool to pause, resume, budget-limit, or usage-limit a goal; those status changes are controlled by the user or system.
When marking a budgeted goal achieved with status `complete`, report the final token usage from the tool result to the user.
tools.name: update_goal

status.description: Required. Set to `complete` only when the objective is achieved and no required work remains. Set to `blocked` only after the same blocking condition has recurred for at least three consecutive goal turns and the agent is at an impasse. After a previously blocked goal is resumed, the resumed run starts a fresh blocked audit.

dependencies.description: 依赖的同批次开发子任务标题。无依赖时必须传 []；元素必须严格等于 tasks 中已存在任务的 title。

description.description: 开发子任务描述，以输入为准，不做任何总结、删减、裁剪操作

executorAgentId.description: 执行该开发子任务的开发 Agent ID

level.description: 任务等级，1 一级任务、2 二级任务，缺省按 2 处理。

parent_task_id.description: 父任务 ID，仅作协议回显，实际父子关系由会话一级任务决定。

productType.description: 产品画像类型，代表当前任务所归属的用户画像，以输入为准。

resources.description: 任务资源，即当前开发任务所依赖的相关资料，可以是用户上传的文件或者分析过程中产生的文件资料。外部资料资源需保留 source、fileUuid、name、fileType、size 等原始字段。

fileType.description: 资源文件类型，例如 md。

localPath.description: 本地资源路径，即相关资料文件在磁盘存储的全路径地址。

size.description: 资源大小，单位由来源系统定义。

source.description: 外部资料来源，例如 dmc。

task_type.description: 任务类型，缺省按 DEVELOPMENT_TASK 处理。

title.description: 开发子任务标题，也是 dependencies 引用的唯一标题。

tools.description: 当多步骤任务执行过程中需要向用户同步阶段性进度时调用。首次调用创建进度卡片，后续每完成一个步骤再次调用更新同一条卡片。不阻塞，调用后立即继续执行。
tools.name: taskProgressUpdated

cardId.description: 进度卡片 ID。首次创建时不传，后续更新时传入上次返回的 cardId。

children.description: 子进度项（可选，支持层级）。

tools.description: 按任务编号批量更新任务状态。入参为 { tasks: [{ task_no: "任务编号", status: "目标状态" }] }；任务不存在时跳过，status 完全按传入值更新。
tools.name: updateTaskStatus

status.description: 目标任务状态，按传入值使用，不做转换。

tools.description: DigiADE runtime context tools.
tools.name: ade_context

tools.description: 获取当前会话所属解决方案信息。返回 solutionId、solutionName、codeRepositories（代码仓库信息列表）；未找到时返回空对象。
tools.name: get_current_solution

tools.description: 获取当前登录用户和租户上下文。返回 sid、userId、userName、tenantId、tenantName、tenantSid、iamToken、appId；未登录时返回空对象。
tools.name: get_current_user_session

tools.description: DigiADE temporary Agent question-answering tools.
tools.name: harness_extension_engine

tools.description: 根据给定上下文回答问题。Main 会创建临时 Codex Agent，等待其回答完成后返回最终文本，并自动删除临时会话。
tools.name: agent

agentName.description: 可选的 Codex Agent 名称；不传时使用默认 Agent。

question.description: 需要临时 Agent 回答的问题。

tools.description: Codex host-provided workspace tools.
tools.name: codex_app

tools.description: Load bundled workspace dependency paths for documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, slides, images, browser automation, and local scripts.
tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies

tools.description: DigiADE host business tools.
tools.name: digiade

tools.description: Create an MVP DigiADE task from analyzed requirement information and return task details for chat display.
tools.name: create_task

tools.description: DigiADE git workflow tools for branch management, commits, and task integration.
tools.name: ade_git

tools.description: 列出所有本地分支（和可选远程分支）。
tools.name: branch_list

remote.description: 是否包含远程分支，默认 false

tools.description: 克隆远程仓库到本地指定路径。如果远程仓库需要认证，会使用已配置的 git 凭证。
tools.name: clone

branch.description: 指定克隆的分支，默认为远程默认分支

target_path.description: 本地目标路径，必须为空目录

tools.description: 提交暂存区的更改。使用 Conventional Commits 格式。
tools.name: commit

files.description: 要暂存的文件路径列表，为空则暂存所有更改

message.description: 提交消息，格式如 "feat(auth): add OAuth2 login support"

tools.description: 配置用户的 git 凭证（Gitea 帐号和 Token/密码），凭证会安全加密存储在本地。
tools.name: configure_credentials

password_or_token.description: Gitea 访问 Token 或密码

server_url.description: Gitea 服务器地址，如 https://gitea.example.com

tools.description: 基于当前 HEAD 创建新分支。分支名必须以 feature/、bugfix/、hotfix/ 或 release/ 开头。
tools.name: create_branch

from.description: 基于哪个分支创建，默认为当前分支

tools.description: 检查系统中是否安装了 git，返回版本和配置信息。如果未安装，返回 installGuide 安装引导。commit 时会自动从 ADE_GIT_USER 兜底。
tools.name: detect

tools.description: 查询当前用户的 git 凭证配置状态（不返回密码）。
tools.name: get_credential_status

tools.description: 获取当前分支的提交历史。
tools.name: log

tools.description: 从远程仓库拉取最新代码。
tools.name: pull

branch.description: 分支名称，默认为当前分支

tools.description: 推送当前分支到远程仓库。不允许对 protected 分支（main/master/develop/release）执行 force push。
tools.name: push

branch.description: 分支名称，默认为当前分支

tools.description: 获取当前代码仓的 git 状态，包括当前分支、领先/落后提交数、文件变更列表。
tools.name: status

tools.description: 智能提交（自动生成 Conventional Commits 格式的提交消息）。可选自动暂存所有文件。
tools.name: task_commit

auto_add.description: 是否自动暂存所有更改，默认 false

tools.description: 完成任务并准备合并。确保所有更改已提交，汇总所有提交记录，可选推送到远程。
tools.name: task_complete

push.description: 是否推送到远程，默认 false

tools.description: 初始化开发任务的 git 环境。自动检测 git 安装状态、凭证配置，并创建规范的 feature 分支。
tools.name: task_init

title.description: 任务标题，用于生成分支名

tools.description: 为指定分支创建 linked worktree，用于并行开发多个任务。支持检出已有分支或创建新分支。
tools.name: worktree_create

from.description: 新分支的起点（仅在 new_branch 为 true 时生效），如 develop、main 或某个 commit hash

new_branch.description: 是否创建新分支（而非检出已有分支），默认 false

path.description: worktree 路径，默认为 ./.worktree/\u003cbranch-name\u003e（分支名中的 / 会替换为 -）。高码任务请传 ./.worktree/adeTask-\u003c任务编号\u003e

tools.description: 列出当前仓库的所有 worktree。
tools.name: worktree_list

tools.description: 移除指定的 worktree。
tools.name: worktree_remove
